headline: Bitcoin Core Issues Security Fix After AI Tool Detects Node Vulnerability
summary: Bitcoin Core shipped fixes for a bug that could allow nodes to stall by repeating a transaction ID 50,000 times. The flaw was identified by Loupe, an open-source AI scanner developed by Block's Spiral team.
why: Bitcoin Core is the main client software running the Bitcoin network. Security updates prevent network disruptions and maintain blockchain consensus integrity.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Bitcoin Core patched a vulnerability that posed node stalling risks.
